subject: #1019 merge step pushed: claude/raise-your-hand @ 820521f1 (merge commit; nine files resolved, doc/registry gates green)
body:
Pushed the #1019 merge step: origin/SignalGrid_Alpha (which now carries DR-056 — you landed #1031 while I worked) merged into claude/raise-your-hand by merge commit 820521f1, no rebase.

It was NINE conflict files, not four. Resolution, file by file:
- docs/DECISION_RECORDS.md — mainline's tail (DR-053, DR-055, DR-056) then DR-054 appended LAST, byte-for-byte from the branch. DR-057 is #1051's (open); Puck 6 takes DR-058.
- .claude/skills/VENDORED.md — mainline's copy; the branch's raised-hands row and EIGHTEEN wording auto-merged; the one conflicting count line re-derived for the merged tree: 119 tracked = 101 upstream + 18 in the table (check-derived-doc-figures derives 119).
- docs/COMPANY_BUILD_PLAN.md — line-count figures from the merged files (preflight.mjs 811, launch-profile.mjs 876; doc-line-counts green).
- docs/LAUNCH_PROFILE.md — 187 classified items (check-launch-profile: launch=28 deferred=135 demo_only=8 internal=16, 187 items, 2 declared gaps; the four totals already matched).
- docs/agent/EVIDENCE.md — mainline's three sections kept, the branch's 2026-09-23 raise-your-hand section inserted before the 2026-09-25 entry (dates stay non-decreasing).
- docs/research/MCP_MARKET_LEADERBOARDS.md — 119 tracked skill directories, 15 dispatchable agents (git ls-files on the merged tree: 15 agents, 17 workflows).
- docs/STATUS.md — mainline's page with the one tree-derived figure corrected (CI workflows 16 → 17; proof gates stay 154). I did NOT keep a regeneration: `status-summary.mjs --write` in the sandboxed worktree mid-merge read RED from environment artifacts (origin unreachable, the merge index counted as 168 uncommitted changes, gates without deps) — regenerate it on the merged tree when you run preflight + breadth.
- docs/agent/SURFACE_REVIEW_COVERAGE.md — regenerated by its writer on the resolved index (104 read / 0 partial / 0 not read of 104).
- scripts/publication-boundary.mjs — the branch's block (mainline's list plus the raised-hands area line).
Also: three claim-inventory citations moved by the merge were re-anchored with the gate's own writer and the Markdown regenerated (ratchet back at absent 2, as mainline).

Gates run on the merged tree (all exit 0): derived-doc-figures (34 figures / 19 docs), doc-line-counts, decision-record-format, cited-paths, surface-review-coverage, preflight↔CI parity, publication-boundary, claim-inventory anchors + drift, launch-profile, docs-sanity, skill-instruction-conflicts, backlog evidence + ownership. NOT run here: full preflight, breadth, raised-hands --check — yours, as you said. The worktree had no node_modules, so anything that needs tsx was not attempted.

Yours from here: raised-hands --check, preflight + breadth on the merged head, PR body, landing; then close #1011 and #1014.
